xna-type.name: NamedValueDictionary
xna-type.interfaces: IDictionary<string, T>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<string, T>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, T>>, IEnumerable
xna-type.summary: Base class for dictionaries that map string identifiers to data values.
xna-type.syntax: public class NamedValueDictionary<T> : IDictionary<string, T>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<string, T>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, T>>, IEnumerable

property.name: Count
property.summary: Gets the number of items in the dictionary.

property.name: DefaultSerializerType
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: protected internal virtual Type DefaultSerializerType { get; }
property.value: The type used by the serializer.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets or sets the specified item.

property.name: Keys
property.summary: Gets all keys contained in the dictionary.
property.value: Collection of keys for the dictionary.

property.name: Values
property.summary: Gets all values contained in the dictionary.
property.value: Collection of values for the dictionary.

method.name: Add
method.summary: Adds the specified key and value to the dictionary.

overload.summary: Adds the specified key and value to the dictionary.

parameters.parameter: Identity of the key of the new data pair.
The value of the new data pair.

method.name: AddItem
method.summary: Adds an element to the dictionary.

overload.summary: Adds an element to the dictionary.
overload.syntax: protected virtual void AddItem ( string key, T value )

parameters.parameter: Identity of the key of the new element.
The value of the new element.

method.name: Clear
method.summary: Removes all keys and values from the dictionary.

overload.summary: Removes all keys and values from the dictionary.

method.name: ClearItems
method.summary: Removes all elements from the dictionary.

overload.summary: Removes all elements from the dictionary.

method.name: ContainsKey
method.summary: Determines whether the specified key is present in the dictionary.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified key is present in the dictionary.
overload.returns: true if the value is present; false otherwise.

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Gets an enumerator that iterates through items in a dictionary.

overload.summary: Gets an enumerator that iterates through items in a dictionary.
overload.returns: Enumerator for iterating through the dictionary.

method.name: Remove
method.summary: Removes the specified key and value from the dictionary.

overload.summary: Removes the specified key and value from the dictionary.

parameters.parameter: Identity of the key to be removed.

overload.returns: true if the value is present; false otherwise.

method.name: RemoveItem
method.summary: Removes the specified element from the dictionary.

overload.summary: Removes the specified element from the dictionary.

parameters.parameter: Identity of the key of the data pair to be removed.

overload.returns: true if the value is present; false otherwise.

method.name: SetItem
method.summary: Modifies the value of an existing element.

overload.summary: Modifies the value of an existing element.
overload.syntax: protected virtual void SetItem ( string key, T value )

parameters.parameter: Identity of the element to be modified.

method.name: TryGetValue
method.summary: Gets the value associated with the specified key.

overload.summary: Gets the value associated with the specified key.

parameters.parameter: Identity of the key of the element whose value is to be retrieved.
[ OutAttribute ] The current value of the element.

overload.returns: true if the value is present; false otherwise.
overload.remarks: If the key was not found, value gets the appropriate default value for the type T . For example, 0 (zero) for integer types, false for Boolean types, and a null reference for reference types.
